# Corpus audio files

This file lists the audio recordings contained in the metadata file used for the evaluation runs.

The metadata contains **1001 recordings**. The filenames below are listed in the same order as the metadata records.

During test execution, two recordings in this run set were identified as defective:

```text
572a0bfaaf94a219006aa77a.wav
5729e500af94a219006aa6b5.wav
```

These files remained part of the recorded run configuration, but were excluded from the validated analysis set. Therefore, the evaluation runs used **1001 recordings**, while **999 recordings** were retained as valid .
